title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 16: the quick fall of Baasha, Elah, Zimri and Tibni, Omri building Samaria, and Ahab marrying Jezebel.

questions.text: Through which prophet did Yahweh's word come against Baasha?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:1 says Yahweh's word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha.
1 Kings 16:6 says Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah.

questions.text: What was Zimri's position before he conspired against Elah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:9 says Zimri, Elah's servant, was captain of half his chariots.

questions.text: What was Elah doing when Zimri struck and killed him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:9-10 says Elah was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, when Zimri went in and killed him.

answers.text: Sleeping in his own bed at noon
Getting drunk in the house of Arza

questions.text: How long did Zimri reign in Tirzah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:15 says Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah.

questions.text: What did Zimri do when he saw that the city was taken?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:18 says he went into the fortified part of the king's house, burned the king's house over him with fire, and died.

answers.text: Fled to the Philistines at Gibbethon
Surrendered to Omri and was spared
Burned the king's house over himself
Fell on his own sword at the gate

questions.text: Whom did half of the people follow to make him king, instead of Omri?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:21 says half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath to make him king, and half followed Omri.

answers.text: Arza, who was over the household

questions.text: From whom did Omri buy the hill Samaria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:24 says Omri bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and named the city after Shemer, the owner of the hill.

questions.text: Whom did Ahab take as his wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:31 says Ahab took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal.

answers.text: The sister of Tahpenes the queen

questions.text: Which city did Hiel the Bethelite build in Ahab's days?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:34 says that in Ahab's days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho, at the loss of his firstborn Abiram and his youngest son Segub.
